mapper.select: SELECT id, title, period_type, period_value, icon, sort_order, created_at FROM daily_plans ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_plans (id, title, period_type, period_value, icon, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{periodType}, #{periodValue}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_plans SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
